filter.description: The status or reason filter applied, or null.

items.description: Contradicted, unresolved and dynamic_only first, then not_checked and verified.

status.description: verified, contradicted, unresolved, dynamic_only or not_checked.

reason.description: Why: verified -> exact, suffixed (A/W), decorated (stdcall _Name@N), forwarded, ordinal, versioned, internal; contradicted -> missing_export, missing_ordinal, bad_ordinal, exact_spelling, ordinal_points_elsewhere, forwarder_broken, arch_mismatch, mangled_only; unresolved -> dll_not_found, api_set_unmapped, not_an_image, system_dll_not_on_host, forwarder_dll_not_found, forwarded_unverified, wrong_platform, malformed_metadata; dynamic_only -> library_loaded_at_run_time, dll_import_resolver; not_checked -> runtime_internal, runtime_library.

location.description: Where malformed metadata was found (stream, table, row, token, file offset), else null.

dynamicLoads.description: Run-time native loading found in the IL (first 20).

kind.description: native_library_load (NativeLibrary.Load/TryLoad), native_library_get_export (NativeLibrary.GetExport/TryGetExport), dll_import_resolver (NativeLibrary.SetDllImportResolver), load_library (a LoadLibrary/dlopen P/Invoke), get_proc_address (a GetProcAddress/dlsym P/Invoke), delegate_for_function_pointer (Marshal.GetDelegateForFunctionPointer).

library.description: The library name passed, when it is a constant (null otherwise).

export.description: The export name passed (or, for a delegate, looked up in the same method), when it is a constant.

metadataIssues.description: Malformed metadata found while reading the declarations, with locations.

code.description: Short code: duplicate_stream, unknown_stream, stream_out_of_range, unknown_tables, extra_data_flag, bad_metadata_root, implmap_scope_out_of_range, implmap_name_out_of_range, implmap_member_out_of_range, moduleref_name_out_of_range, bad_table_index, bad_list_index, bad_coded_index, bad_heap_index, decompiler_reader.

fileOffset.description: File offset of the structure, when known (hex).
